tokens.name: theater-black
tokens.usage: The theater room in act one, and the letterbox surround behind the program monitor picture.

tokens.name: panel-000
tokens.usage: Editor ground: the 4px gutters between panels and the menubar. Clip label text color (see clip-ink).

tokens.name: panel-100
tokens.usage: Panel bodies: project bin, monitor, timeline lanes.

tokens.name: panel-200
tokens.usage: Panel headers, track headers, the timeline ruler, the info pane.

tokens.name: panel-300
tokens.usage: Hover and selected rows in the bin, pressed transport buttons. Only ink and ink-muted text on it.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px hairlines between lanes, rows and panel headers. Decorative only, never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (buttons, link chips), ruler major ticks. 3:1 on panel-000 to panel-200.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every panel and on theater-black. Also the focus ring.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: item counts, years, durations, inactive tabs. 5.5:1 or better on panel-000 to panel-300.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Ruler tick labels and column headers on panel-000 to panel-200 only (4.7:1 on panel-200). Never on panel-300.

tokens.name: playhead
tokens.usage: THE signal color: the playhead line and cap, the current timecode, the pressed play button, the loading-screen dot, the cursor cue highlight. One per region; never decorative. Contrast note: as a mark it clears 3:1 on panel-000 to panel-200, but as text (the current timecode) it is 3.4 to 3.9:1, under the 4.5:1 floor for 14px text; a lighter value such as #2b93d1 would fix it. Links use link, its light tint.

tokens.name: on-playhead
tokens.usage: Text or icon drawn on a playhead fill.

tokens.name: clip-video
tokens.usage: Video clips on V1 (footage). Full strength ONLY on the clip under the playhead (live), label in clip-ink.

tokens.name: clip-image
tokens.usage: Still-image clips on V1 when a project has no video (the carousel). Full strength ONLY on the clip under the playhead (live), label in clip-ink.

tokens.name: clip-text
tokens.usage: Title and caption clips on V3, and the readme clip of text-only projects. Full strength ONLY on the clip under the playhead (live), label in clip-ink.

tokens.name: clip-fx
tokens.usage: Adjustment clips on V2 (grade, grain). Full strength ONLY on the clip under the playhead (live), label in clip-ink.

tokens.name: clip-audio
tokens.usage: Audio clips on A1 and A2. Full strength ONLY on the clip under the playhead (live), label in clip-ink.

tokens.name: clip-ink
tokens.usage: Labels on every clip fill (6:1 or better on each clip color).

tokens.name: clip-video-dim
tokens.usage: Video clips at rest (not under the playhead). Label in clip-ink-dim.

tokens.name: clip-image-dim
tokens.usage: Image clips at rest. Label in clip-ink-dim.

tokens.name: clip-text-dim
tokens.usage: Title and lyric clips at rest. Label in clip-ink-dim.

tokens.name: clip-fx-dim
tokens.usage: Adjustment clips at rest. Label in clip-ink-dim.

tokens.name: clip-audio-dim
tokens.usage: Audio clips at rest; waveform in clip-ink-dim at 35%.

tokens.name: clip-ink-dim
tokens.usage: Labels on every -dim clip fill (6:1 or better on each).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links in the info pane and the mobile info sheet: the one bright thing in the left column. A light tint of playhead, 8:1 on panel-200. Never on clips or chrome.

tokens.name: screen
tokens.usage: The lit movie screen, its glow, and credit text drawn over footage.

tokens.name: velvet
tokens.usage: Theater curtains framing the screen in act one.

tokens.name: velvet-deep
tokens.usage: Curtain folds, the shadow side of each drape.

tokens.name: seat
tokens.usage: Seat-back silhouettes in the theater rows.

tokens.name: seat-edge
tokens.usage: The lit top edge of each seat back, catching screen light.

tokens.name: aisle-light
tokens.usage: Tiny step lights along the theater aisles. Same value as clip-fx on purpose: warm practical light.

tokens.name: award-gold
tokens.usage: Every award in the bin, the info pane and the mobile gallery: text and award icon, with a slow sheen.

tokens.name: award-gold-hi
tokens.usage: Highlight that sweeps across gold awards.

styles.name: film-title
styles.usage: The movie title on the theater screen. One per page.

styles.name: credit-name
styles.usage: The name under Directed by. Italic.

styles.name: project-title
styles.usage: Project name in the info pane and on text-only readme cards.

styles.name: credit-label
styles.usage: Credit roles, set in uppercase. Always above a credit-name.

styles.name: timecode
styles.usage: Current time (in playhead) and durations (in ink-muted). HH:MM:SS:FF at 24fps, tabular.

styles.name: panel-title
styles.usage: Panel tabs and column headers, uppercase.

styles.name: ui-strong
styles.usage: Selected bin row, the active workspace tab.

styles.name: clip-label
styles.usage: Text inside clips, in clip-ink, truncated with an ellipsis.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Project descriptions in the info pane. Max 60ch.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Panel gutters, icon to label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Row padding, clip label inset.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Panel body padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Info pane padding, gaps between transport groups.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Theater credits spacing, cover insets.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large separations in act one.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: The movie screen, the monitor picture. Film is square.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Clips, meters, the playhead cap.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels, buttons, link chips.

tokens.name: screen-glow
tokens.usage: Light spill around the movie screen in act one.

tokens.name: panel-pop
tokens.usage: Menus and the editor as it lands after the zoom. Panels at rest have no shadow.

tokens.name: menubar-h
tokens.usage: Editor menubar with the workspace tabs (the site nav).

tokens.name: panel-header-h
tokens.usage: Every panel's tab strip.

tokens.name: footer-h
tokens.usage: The status-bar footer: email, GitHub, LinkedIn, X, YouTube.

tokens.name: ruler-h
tokens.usage: Timeline ruler.

tokens.name: track-h
tokens.usage: One track lane and its header.

tokens.name: track-header-w
tokens.usage: Width of the track header column.

tokens.name: bin-w
tokens.usage: Project bin column on desktop.

tokens.name: timeline-h
tokens.usage: Timeline panel height on desktop: header, ruler and exactly five track-h lanes, no empty space below.
